summary: Flathead NF lookout in Flathead County, MT: a 10-foot pole L-4 tower built in 1931 and destroyed in 1961; the site lies in the Great Bear Wilderness.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1961 according to firelookout.com; no later structure is described in the sources read.

access.note: The site is inside the Great Bear Wilderness on Flathead National Forest land. No source describes a route to the site or what stands there now.

visit.trail_note: No trail or route to the site is described in the sources read.

events.note: Built as a 10-foot pole L-4 tower, per firelookout.com
Destroyed in 1961; firelookout.com gives no cause

evidence.supports: built 1931 as a 10-foot pole L-4 tower; destroyed 1961
evidence.quote: Built in 1931, this 10' pole L-4 tower was destroyed in 1961.

evidence.supports: site inside the Great Bear Wilderness
L-4 described as a standard design with a gabled roof and windows on every side
evidence.quote: Fickes developed standard plans for a lookout building with a gable roof and windows on all sides known as the L-4

Trails of the Past: Historical Overview of the Flathead National Forest

notes_for_editor: Build and destruction years rest on one detailed listing (firelookout.com); the Forest Fire Lookout Association index confirms only that the tower is gone. Two searches and the Flathead history turned up no staffing, fire or photo record for this site. The site is in designated wilderness, so access is marked public as national forest land, but no source states visiting rules or describes what remains. The brief's record (Flathead NF, tower, gone, access unknown) matches the sources; no corrections proposed.
